forced_hopper_prepare.symptom: Finalist graph launch br_run CUDA=1 after constructing all configurations
forced_hopper_prepare.cause: Two configs share a kernel specialization. Preparing the two-CTA80KiB reservation lowered its maximum dynamic-smem attribute after a one-CTA120KiB cell had already been prepared.
forced_hopper_prepare.fix: Prepare sets the specialization limit to the device opt-in maximum; each launch retains its own120/80KiB reservation.
forced_hopper_prepare.coverage: Forced Hopper prepare branch,132/264 grid, native ring stand-ins on the100KiB local GPU. Full batch rerun after the fix.

initial_resource_audit.symptom: Hopper ptxas spilled16-84 bytes on some large token tiles
initial_resource_audit.fix: Explicit __launch_bounds__(128,1) lets ptxas spend registers. All33 specializations subsequently compile with zero spills.
